# FOXI TAXI — Full Documentation

> FOXI TAXI is a technology-powered taxi dispatch platform connecting local taxi operators with customers across Central and Eastern Europe.

## Overview

FOXI TAXI provides a unified taxi dispatch service with local operators in each city. Customers call a single local number, and the platform dispatches the nearest available driver.

Website: https://www.foxi.taxi

## How It Works

1. Customer calls the local FOXI TAXI number or taps the call button on the website
2. The dispatch platform assigns the nearest available driver
3. The driver arrives at the customer's location and completes the ride

## Key Features

- **Fast Pickup**: Average arrival time under 5 minutes in city center
- **Safe & Reliable**: Professional drivers, insured vehicles, tracked rides
- **Fair Pricing**: No surge pricing — transparent fares
- **24/7 Available**: Day and night, weekdays and weekends

## URL Structure

- Language homepage: https://www.foxi.taxi/{lang}/
- City page: https://www.foxi.taxi/{lang}/{city-slug}/
- Example: https://www.foxi.taxi/sk/trebisov/
